title: Frontend application loads and exposes login flow
description: Verify the React/Vite frontend loads from the configured remote URL and the login page is reachable.
steps: Navigate to /login
Verify the page renders without a network or JavaScript fatal error
Verify login form controls are visible

title: Inventory UI consumes variation inventory safely
description: Verify authenticated inventory views can load data with packaging variation fields and no visible 500 crash.
steps: Authenticate with configured test credentials if required
Navigate to the inventory section
Verify inventory data loads from GET /api/inventory/
Verify product variation fields such as packaging size, pieces per packet, packets per box, and category do not break rendering

title: Production entry supports variation selection
description: Verify the daily production page allows selecting product variation and shift details before submitting production boxes.
steps: Authenticate with configured test credentials if required
Navigate to the production entry page
Open product and packaging variation selectors
Enter produced boxes and shift
Submit the form and verify the UI does not show a failed API/network error

title: Sales invoice warns on insufficient variation stock
description: Verify the billing/sales form selects inventory variations and warns when entered boxes exceed available stock.
steps: Authenticate with configured test credentials if required
Navigate to the sales or billing page
Select a product variation from inventory-backed options
Enter a sold box quantity larger than available stock
Verify an Insufficient Stock warning appears and submission is blocked

title: Outstanding payment dues tracker renders and triggers reminders
description: Verify the dashboard dues tracker displays pending dues and calls the automation reminder route.
steps: Authenticate as an owner or permitted user
Navigate to the dashboard
Locate Outstanding Payment Dues Tracker
Verify table columns for customer, phone, invoice reference, total bill, pending balance, and status
Click Trigger Automated WhatsApp Reminders Now and verify a success or handled error toast
